title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Helicopter Flight) (No. 10) Regulations 2026
The Service and Administration Charges (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision about service charges and administration charges in relation to leases of dwellings in England.

title: The Scotland Act 1998 (Agency Arrangements) (Specification) (Digital Waste Tracking) Order 2026
summary: This Order paves the way for the Scottish Ministers and a Minister of the Crown to enter into agency arrangements, under which a Minister of the Crown can exercise certain functions of the designated person acting under, or in accordance with, any regulations made under section 34CA of the Environmental Protection Act 1990. Any such arrangements would be agreed between Ministers of the Crown and the Scottish Ministers.

title: The Withdrawal Agreement (Windsor Framework and Governance) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: Regulation 2(6) omits section 15C of the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018 to allow the United Kingdom co-chair to consent to the Joint Committee adopting decisions or recommendations by written procedure for the period in between meetings, provided for in Rule 9(1) of Annex VIII of the Withdrawal Agreement.

title: The National Health Service (Pharmaceutical and Local Pharmaceutical Services) (Amendment) (No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make amendments to the National Health Service (Pharmaceutical and Local Pharmaceutical Services) Regulations 2013 (“the PLPS Regulations”). The PLPS Regulations govern arrangements, in England, for the provision of pharmaceutical services and local pharmaceutical services under Part 7 of the National Heath Service Act 2006.

title: The Collective Investment Schemes (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make an amendment to the Collective Investment Schemes (Amendment etc.) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 (S.I. 2019/325) (“CIS Regulations”), regarding temporary recognition for the purposes of Part 17 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (c. 8).

title: The Feed-in Tariffs (Amendment) (British Industrial Competitiveness Scheme Excluded Electricity) Order 2026
summary: This Order is made in exercise of the powers in sections 43(3)(a) and 104(2) of the Energy Act 2008 (c. 32). It amends the Feed-in Tariffs Order 2012 (S.I. 2012/2782) to make amendments as to how annual levelisation payments are calculated under article 27 of that Order. In particular, this Order introduces an exemption from that calculation for electricity supplied to customers operating in certain manufacturing sectors, under the British Industrial Competitiveness Scheme.

title: The Building Insurance Information (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make provision regarding information about insurance that a landlord must give to a tenant where a service charge includes an amount payable for that insurance. They concern leases of dwellings in England.

title: The Marine Licensing (Exempted Activities and Fees) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Marine Licensing (Exempted Activities) Order 2011 (S.I. 2011/409) (“the 2011 Order”) and the Marine Licensing (Application Fees) Regulations 2014 (S.I. 2014/615) (“the Fees Regulations”).

title: The Radio Selection Services (Designation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations designate a number of radio selection services for the purposes of Part 3B of the Communications Act 2023 (c. 21) (regulation of radio selection services).

The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (RAF Feltwell, Norfolk) (Emergency) Regulations 2026

The Education (Student Loans) (Repayment) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Education (Student Loans) (Repayment) Regulations 2009 (S.I. 2009/470) (“the Repayment Regulations”) which make provision for the repayment of income-contingent student loans in England and Wales.

title: The Registration of Births and Deaths (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary:
These Regulations amend the 
Registration of Births and Deaths Regulations 1987 (S.I. 1987/2088) (“the 1987 Regulations”) and the 
Registration of Births and Deaths (Welsh Language) Regulations 1987 (S.I. 1987/2089) (“the Welsh Language Regulations”).

title: The Renewables Obligation and Electricity Capacity (Amendment) (British Industrial Competitiveness Scheme Excluded Electricity) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made in exercise of the powers in sections 32, 32A, 32J and 32K of the Electricity Act 1989 (c. 29) and sections 27, 28, 30, 32, 33 and 40 of the Energy Act 2013 (c. 32). They make provision about BICS excluded electricity, which is a proportion of electricity measured by meters in respect of a manufacturing site which is used to carry out certain manufacturing activities (defined as “specified activity” in these Regulations). BICS excluded electricity is then excluded from the calculations of a supplier’s liability under the Renewables Obligation Order 2015 (S.I. 2015/1947), the Electricity Capacity (Supplier Payment etc.) Regulations 2014 (S.I. 2014/3354) and the Electricity Capacity (Supplier Payment etc.) (Amendment and Excluded Electricity) Regulations 2024 (S.I. 2024/434).

The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Hampstead) Regulations 2026
The Registration of Births and Deaths (England and Wales) (Specified Requirements) Regulations 2026
summary: Under the Births and Deaths Registration Act 1953, certain people are required to attend the register office to give information about a birth, death or still-birth, and physically sign the register. Section 38B of that Act allows the Minister to specify requirements and to provide that the duty to sign the register has effect as a duty to comply with those specified requirements. If the requirements are complied with, the person will be taken to have signed the register and, where relevant, do have done so in the presence of the registrar.

title: The Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (Commencement No. 10) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force sections 61 to 65 of the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (c. 18) (“the 2025 Act”). Regulation 2(1) brings the provisions specified in that regulation into force on 9th November 2026. Regulation 2(2) brings section 61(3) of the 2025 Act into force at 12.01 am on that date. These are the 10th commencement regulations made under the 2025 Act.
